pipeline.quotes: CNBC real-time -> Yahoo v7 -> Stooq -> latest session close; crypto via CoinGecko (per-row quote.source, quote.realTime)
pipeline.history: Yahoo adjusted close -> Nasdaq API (stocks/etf) -> Stooq; crypto via CoinGecko; indices via proxy ETF scaled to the index level (per-file meta.source)
pipeline.refreshedBy: GitHub Actions "Update Pages market data": every 5 min on weekdays 13-22 UTC, every 30 min otherwise, and on pushes to the code branch. Fails loudly (exit 1) when no symbol could be fetched.
